title: Snoqualmie falls and Twin Falls Hike
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: What makes this tour unique is that I am focused on keeping you very well entertained and educated while we make our way to the gorgeous Twin Falls and Snoqualmie Falls. The ride to the Falls and back is full of information about the Pacific Northwest as well as entertaining stories, a whole Lotta fun facts and a bit of comedy. I’ve been a naturalist Guide for nearly 20 years, and I have refined the content of my tours to maximize enjoyment and education! I am very passionate about our planet, consciousness, and all things paranormal and supernatural. Ladies, if you are looking for a tour that will keep your husbands or boyfriends thoroughly entertained with content about UFOs, aliens, Bigfoot, and many other mysterious and intriguing paranormal activities. This is the tour for you!
